info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Clearing Transactions API
info.description: The Card Clearing Transactions API facilitates the processing of payment clearings involving card transactions. This endpoint allows businesses to submit clearing requests after transactions have been authorized, ensuring timely and accurate settlement. It is designed for financial institutions and payment processors looking to manage their card clearing operations efficiently. By leveraging this API, users can streamline their payment workflows and enhance their reconciliation processes.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a clearing transaction for card payments. It processes the clearing based on the provided card information and transaction details, enabling the settlement of funds between banks.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a card clearing operation. It contains the necessary details for processing the card clearing transaction, including card information and transaction specifics.
